verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is an API-key-authenticated HTTP service. The docs show scripted curl requests and a quick first request with a key, which makes it inherently headless and scriptable. Automation use is further supported by an official n8n community node and an official MCP server for agent pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions, secret handling), an official CLI or SDK for scripted use, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
